content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe is severely restricted, digital creators struggle to set up online stores to sell ebooks, courses, and software. Without access to conventional payment gateways, they're forced to rely on expensive workarounds or abandon their businesses altogether. But what if you could build a crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-works-how|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages, without relying on Stripe or any other platform? With COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions, you can deploy a fast, secure, and scalable e-commerce stack in just 4-6 hours, using The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) as a guide. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-selling-presets-without-stripe|The No-Nonsense]] guide will walk you through the process of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-which-architecture-actually|setting]] up a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, from payment and delivery pipeline setup to scaling your infrastructure once it's running.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Crypto store

The key to building a robust e-commerce infrastructure lies in ownership and control. When platforms like Stripe fail or impose restrictions, your business is left vulnerable. But with COREMERCH's solutions, you own and control every layer of your stack, from payment processing to product delivery. This means you're not reliant on any single platform, and your business can thrive even in the face of restrictions or outages. By deploying a sovereign e-commerce stack, you're building a future-proof business that can adapt to changing circumstances and scale as needed.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can set up a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to gather a few essential tools and resources. First, you'll need a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account, as you'll be using Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages for hosting. Next, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will handle your cryptocurrency payments. Finally, you'll need to download The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides comprehensive documentation and source code for all 5 stacks. With these tools in hand, you're ready to start deploying your e-commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in building a robust e-commerce infrastructure. With NOWPayments, you can integrate cryptocurrency payments into your store, and with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can deliver products to your customers. The key is to automate these processes as much as possible, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic and automate tasks. By streamlining your payment and delivery pipeline, you can reduce costs and improve customer satisfaction.
A sovereign e-commerce stack gives you ownership and control of every layer, from payment processing to product delivery.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. This is an exciting moment, as you'll finally be able to sell your products and earn revenue. To ensure a smooth transition, make sure to test your infrastructure thoroughly before going live. This includes testing payment processing, product delivery, and any other critical components of your stack. By taking the time to thoroughly test your infrastructure, you can avoid costly errors and ensure a successful launch.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows and your infrastructure becomes more complex, you'll need to scale your e-commerce stack to meet increasing demand. This may involve upgrading your hosting, adding new payment gateways, or implementing more advanced automation tools. The key is to stay flexible and adapt to changing circumstances, using The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) as a guide to help you navigate the scaling process. By scaling your infrastructure proactively, you can ensure a smooth user experience and maintain a competitive edge in the market.
Does Cloudflare take crypto?

The most important question to ask when building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages is: How do I ensure a smooth payment processing experience for my customers? The answer lies in automating your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and by integrating cryptocurrency payments using NOWPayments. This will help you reduce costs, improve customer satisfaction, and ensure a successful launch.
Automating your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can reduce costs and improve customer satisfaction.

If you're looking for more information on e-commerce infrastructure or digital product sales, be sure to check out The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for comprehensive documentation and source code. You can also explore COREMERCH's product offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, including the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack. Additionally, you can learn more about Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments by visiting their respective websites.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
